KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. mato

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

6. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

7. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. nene
   C. pana
   D. zito

8. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

9. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
